nom: Bioderma Atoderm Intensive Balm for Very Dry to Atopic Skin

segments.dry: The large majority of reviewers, across ages and climates, report the balm relieves very dry, cracked or flaking skin on hands, feet, face and body, often within days, though a few say the moisture doesn't last past about 12 hours or don't notice a clear difference.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, eczema-prone or atopic skin, including children's skin, consistently report it calms itching, redness and flare-ups without stinging, though one reviewer says it stung her daughter's eczema and didn't help.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily combination skin used it only at night and reports her flaky patches, bumps and redness resolved after a long period of unsuccessfully trying other approaches.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as ideal for her mature, dry skin, absorbing quickly without greasy residue.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report significant, often fast relief from severe dryness and cracking on hands, feet and face, with several noting results within days; a minority say the hydration fades within about 12 hours or that they didn't notice a real difference.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced redness, on their own skin or their children's, alongside less itching and fewer bumps within days of starting use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe the balm as repairing or restoring a damaged skin barrier, citing ingredients aimed at that function.
concerns.aging: One reviewer reports her fine lines appeared filled in within a few days of use.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick texture suited to severe dryness
Can feel tacky or greasy for a while after application
Hard to get the last third of product out of the tube
Pricey relative to how quickly it's used
Unclear instructions on where it can be applied

extraits.titre: Good, not great for dry, sensitive skin
extraits.texte: On paper, this is probably the most ideal cream for dry sensitive skin, however I found in my experience (dry skin in a dry enviroment) it didn't provide moisture that would last for more than 12 hours at best, which wasn't ideal as i don't enjoy having to apply lotion multiple times a day. Also, the moisture it did provide required me to use a sizeable amount everyday, which meant that I ran out of the cream in about 2 months, which seemed a bit too fast for how expensive the cream is. Additionally, the packaging--while nice--made it difficult to get the last third of the cream out. Finally, a minor issue which affected me was that it did make my skin quite sticky for at least a couple hours after application which over time became a bit annoying. That being said if my skin was irritated (burning/itchy) I wouldn't say it was the best at treating it.
While this seems like a decent cream in general, it still was uncomfortable for my daughter to use. She gets itchy and bumpy eczema on her hands and elbows and this didn't work for her.

Its thick & rich but thats great for winter eczema. It has. Soothed & moisturized my super dry skin. Less redness, less tightness, lesss bumps. I use this at night after shower bc its thick & it takes a bit to soak in, but in the morning my skin feels amazing.

I received this complimentary product for my honest review. My son suffers from very dry skin and some areas on his body has eczema as well. He was looking forward to trying this product on his dry hands and fingers that have been suffering all winter. The balm instantly soothes his itchiness and dryness (see before and after pictures). I love that it is long lasting and you can apply it everywhere, including your face. Although he has only applied it on his hands and legs that suffer from eczema, it has worked very well. I love how smooth it feels and spreads easily without leaving a greasy feeling. I'm looking forward to seeing more results, the longer we use it.

I have had good skin my entire life, with the occasional breakout of course but otherwise normal clear skin. Until suddenly at 29 my skin got very red, bumpy, itchy, flakey… 24/7. I tried sticking to my normal skin care routine; that didn't help. I tried switching to natural skincare, that didn't work either! So i tried doing nothing, no soap, no moisturizer… nope! This was over a year of struggling with no resolution. Until i found this!! I have oily combination skin so i only use this at night but WOW! I no longer have flakey patches, the bumpy skin has totally gone away and even the redness has drastically decreased. Im so happy and so blow away. I definitely recommend this lotion!

extraits.titre: Deeply hydrate and restore my skin barrier
extraits.texte: Bioderma Atoderm Intensive Balm is an excellent choice for very dry, sensitive, or eczema-prone skin. It has a rich, soothing formula that provides deep hydration and helps restore the skin barrier. The balm absorbs well without feeling overly greasy, making it comfortable for daily use. It contains ingredients like lipids and Bioderma's Skin Barrier Therapy™ to help reduce irritation and prevent flare-ups. If you struggle with dryness or itchiness, this balm is a great option for long-lasting relief and skin comfort.

This moisturizer is perfect for my mature, dry skin. It goes on easily and absorbs quickly and completely, without leaving any greasy residue behind. It calms and soothes my sensitive irritated skin. I appreciate that it lacks a smell. This one is perfect for anyone with skin ailments, especially in cold and dry climates.
